rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent bar-based mass with a legible carved longitudinal void, and it responds acceptably to the parcel and frontage rather than simply filling the box. The blue access edge is not sealed; the top view and oblique views show a meaningful open seam/void aligned as a public threshold. The form is still somewhat generic and a bit box-like, but it maintains hierarchy and a clear dominant gesture, so it can plausibly support neighborhood living / mixed-use semantics at this early stage. No visible view collision or incoherent sectional contradiction is apparent.
